answer: A terraced horizon bond stops fakes: no bid above ten units clears until the bidder locks a 12-unit bond across three terraces, each terrace releasing after one verified job per epoch. Two peers check each job in 48 hours, client-countersigned. A forged job or skipped terrace burns the whole bond and drops the claimant to its nadir. Honest agents climb and keep it; 100 fakes need 300 verified jobs and risk 1,200 units.
